All correct. Summary of changes:

**`rebalance` extracted** — the 4-case balancing block is pulled out of `insert` into its own `private static <T> Node<T> rebalance(Node<T>)`. `insert` now reads as pure BST insertion logic: descend, update height, rebalance. This also means rebalance is available when deletion is added later without duplication.

**Traversals return `List<T>`** — `preOrder()` and `inOrder()` now collect keys into a `List<T>` and return it instead of printing. The data structure no longer has a hard dependency on `System.out`; callers decide what to do with the result (print, assert, log, etc.). The private recursive helpers take the accumulator list as a parameter.

**`contains` added** — standard BST search using `compareTo`, mirroring the structure of `insert`. Without it the tree is write-only and not useful as a data structure.
